Our mission is to deliver personalized care that prioritizes your overall health and wellness, inside and out. Services we Offer Med Spa Direct Primary Care Meet Our Team of Doctors Dr. Kathryn Brokus Dr. Brokus leads both our Direct Primary Care and Med Spa services. She specializes in osteopathic medicine, hormone replacement, weight loss, Botox for migraines, and aesthetic treatments—offering compassionate, whole-body care that helps you feel your best inside and out. About Dr. Brokus Melissa Cantara, BSN-RN Melissa supports both our Direct Primary Care and Med Spa services with expert nursing care. As a seasoned nurse injector, she specializes in Botox , dermal fillers , and semaglutide for weight loss, while also assisting with medical treatments and wellness support across every service we provide.
